fixtures.name: Klebsiella pneumoniae ST258 (MDR / Carbapenem-resistant)
fixtures.description: High-risk nosocomial ST258 lineage carrying blaKPC-2 carbapenemase, blaCTX-M-15 ESBL, aac(6')-Ib-cr, sul1, tet(A), oqxA/B, and intrinsic blaSHV-11.

fixtures.name: Escherichia coli ST131 (ESBL / Ciprofloxacin-resistant)
fixtures.description: Prevalent extraintestinal pathogenic E. coli carrying blaCTX-M-14, blaTEM-1B, aac(3)-IIa, and chromosomal gyrA_S83L and parC_S80I mutations.

fixtures.name: Staphylococcus aureus USA300 (MRSA)
fixtures.description: Methicillin-resistant S. aureus USA300 carrying SCCmec IV cassette (mecA PBP2a), blaZ, and erm(A).

fixtures.name: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 (Wild-type Pan-susceptible)
fixtures.description: Wild-type reference genome with zero acquired resistance determinants or known resistance mutations.
